title: Demo: 3-email sequence for the new exceptions dashboard
brief:
Audience: existing customers' accounts payable leads.
Output: a 3-email sequence that announces the new exceptions dashboard and gets them to try it this month.
Decision: whether to lead with time saved or with fewer late payments.

plan.rationale: Default plan for content-piece: strategy positioning, then content. The brief says "3-email sequence", so the content task uses email-sequence, not content-piece. I added one ab-test-design task because the brief asks to decide "whether to lead with time saved or with fewer late payments"; the sequence will run that test. Risk: "fewer late payments" is not an approved claim in the product file, so that variant needs evidence or must stay a hypothesis. The release-notes link is a placeholder, so dashboard details will be marked [add: ...].
